snippet.title: Love Cult: an otome inspired by Cult of the Lamb
snippet.description:
Love Cult - an otome inspired by Cult of the Lamb
A dark romance game about saving the world with your cult followers to spread love, featuring a GxB/GxG romance!

Available on Steam with a free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474870/Love_Cult
